description.en: A straight trunk carries repeated deciduous lateral branch systems bearing cones.
description.zh: 直干上反复着生可脱落的侧枝系统，侧枝带球状孢子叶穗。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Paralycopodites; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Paralycopodites 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Side-branch architecture along the trunk differs from the terminal crown of the existing Lepidodendron.
distinctness.zh: 沿干分布的侧枝结构区别于现有鳞木的顶端树冠。

modeling_brief.en: Build tiered asymmetric side systems around a continuous leader; keep cone placements tied to cited branch diagrams.
modeling_brief.zh: 沿连续主干建立分层不对称侧枝，孢子叶穗位置以所引图示为准。

assets.uncertainty: Not a synonym-derived extra Lepidodendron variant; exact branch longevity is not animated.

description.en: A slender climbing seed plant bears divided fern-like foliage and glandular surface structures.
description.zh: 细攀援种子植物带分裂蕨状叶及腺状表面结构。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Lyginopteris oldhamia; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Lyginopteris oldhamia 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Climbing stem framework and gland-bearing axes differ from an independent fern rosette.
distinctness.zh: 攀援茎架及具腺枝轴区别于独立蕨类莲座。

modeling_brief.en: Use a sparse supported stem and divided leaf fans; represent only the larger gland bases, not microscopic hairs.
modeling_brief.zh: 用疏开的攀附茎和分裂叶扇建形，仅表现较大腺基，不制作显微毛。

assets.uncertainty: Lagenostoma reproductive organs are associated with this concept and must not be separately counted.

description.en: A comparatively slender stem supports very large compound fronds.
description.zh: 相对纤细茎体支撑庞大的复叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Medullosa; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Medullosa 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Oversized compound fronds on a limited stem framework differ from the existing short armored cycad's stiff pinnate crown.
distinctness.zh: 有限茎架上的巨型复叶区别于现有短甲胄苏铁的硬羽状叶冠。

modeling_brief.en: Block out heavy frond petioles and broad multilayered leaf fans; select a supported self-standing habit.
modeling_brief.zh: 先构建粗重叶柄与宽多级叶扇，选择有依据的自立生长型。

assets.uncertainty: Medullosans included multiple growth habits; the selected concept is not universal for the genus.

description.en: A woody branching plant bears long parallel-veined strap leaves.
description.zh: 木质分枝植物带细长平行脉带状叶。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Cordaites; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Cordaites 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Broad strap foliage on woody limbs differs from both the existing conifer's narrow sprays and cycad pinnate fronds.
distinctness.zh: 木质枝上的宽带叶区别于现有针叶树窄叶枝及苏铁羽状叶。

modeling_brief.en: Use broad simple leaf ribbons on an airy woody framework; select a documented upland or wetland habit before scene placement.
modeling_brief.zh: 在疏开木质枝架上布置宽单叶带，场景摆放前选定有据旱地或湿地型。

assets.uncertainty: Cordaitalean habits varied; whole-tree crown is a cautious generic reconstruction.
